# workflows.CreateScheduleInput

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

Creates a tenant schedule for a schedulable workflow.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `workflows.CreateScheduleInput` |
| Kind | `command` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.schedule.write` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cron` | yes | `none` | 5-field cron expression; at least 15 minutes between fires. |  |
| `inputData` | no | `personal` | Workflow input; validated by the workflow's own schema on the server. |  |
| `slug` | yes | `none` | Unique per organization; part of the schedule id. |  |
| `timezone` | yes | `none` | IANA time zone of the cron expression; required. |  |
| `workflowId` | yes | `none` | Workflow to schedule; it must be schedulable. |  |

## Relations

_None._

## Examples

```json
[
  {
    "workflowId": "usage-report",
    "slug": "daily-usage",
    "cron": "0 9 * * *",
    "timezone": "America/Sao_Paulo",
    "inputData": {}
  }
]
```
